title: Grateful Dead Live at Carrier Dome, Syracuse U on 1982-09-24
source: AUD (Beyer 88Âs) > MC > DAT > CDR via Raoul Duke encoded by Matt Vernon

ai_review.summary: A strong audience tape of the funky 1982 Dead, highlighted by a smoking Crazy Fingers/Playin run and an epic Sugar Mag jam, captured with surprisingly clear dome sound.
ai_review.review: Listeners rave about the solid first‑set work (Jack Straw, Ramble On Rose, the LL Rain China → Rider close) and a second set that turns on a funky drum groove, a fiery Playin > Crazy Fingers sequence and an unforgettable Iko → Truckin → Sugar Mag stretch.  The audience recording from the dome is praised for its bottom‑end punch and clarity despite typical venue challenges, making it one of the better 1982 tapes available.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 4‑5) and enthusiastic comments about both musical performance and surprisingly good tape sound push the rating into the ‘good‑to‑great’ range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience capture from the dome praised for strong bottom end, clear drum presence and overall clarity—unusual for that venue; no major dropouts reported.

standout_songs: Iko Iko > Truckin' > Goin' Down the Road Feelin' Bad > Black Peter > Round & Round > Sugar Magnolia
show_quality.setlist_flow: Full, well‑rounded first set with classic early‑80s selections and a tight LL Rain China → Rider close; second set shifts to funkier grooves and an extended post‑drums jam that keeps the energy high.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jerry’s guitar is described as ‘growling seriously’ in the later part of the show, showing he was fully into the performance.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir is noted running wildly around the stage and leaping onto a speaker stack during the Sugar Magnolia jam, adding visual excitement.
band_member_comments.Drums: Reviewers highlight a newly developed funky, drum‑oriented groove in 1982 and praise an after‑drums sequence that drives the second set.
